newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slide as foreign buyers hold off.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slide as foreign buyers hold off.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 1.84 percent on Thursday, the third straight day of losses, and traders said there was little sign of a recovery while foreign investors held back.
"Prices will remain low until foreign investors return to the market, which may take a couple of weeks," said Goran Spasenic of brokerage BPH.
The central bank created a mood of uncertainty last week when it ruled international investors must open special accounts in order to trade Slovenia's securities.
* The SBI index fell 26.26 points to 1,404.06.
* Overall eight shares fell, five rose and four were unchanged, while eight were untraded.
* Bank SKB was the most active, falling 3.44 percent to 58,900 tolars on volume of 2,742 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
